articles.title: Police Seek Information on Kian Walmsley, 20, Wanted for Notification Breach
articles.excerpt: Kian Walmsley, 20, is wanted for failing to comply with sex offenders’ notification requirements. He has links to Rochdale and surrounding areas.
articles.content_html:
A man is wanted by police for failing to comply with sex offenders’ notification requirements. Kian Walmsley, 20, is described as 5ft 10, slim, with light brown hair.

Walmsley has links to Crawshawbooth and the Rossendale area, as well as to Rochdale. Authorities are urging anyone with information about his whereabouts to come forward.

The police have not disclosed any further details regarding the circumstances of the breach or any previous incidents.

Anyone with information can find Greater Manchester Police and Crimestoppers contact details at the end of this article.

articles.title: Rochdale Friends Complete 1,500km Arctic Ascent Cycling Challenge
articles.excerpt: A group of friends from Rochdale has raised over £122,000 for Springhill Hospice by completing a 1,500km cycling challenge in the Arctic.
articles.content_html:
A group of friends from Rochdale has completed a 1,500km cycling challenge called the Arctic Ascent. The event raised more than £122,000 for Springhill Hospice.

The cyclists undertook the challenge to support the hospice, which provides care for patients with life-limiting illnesses. Their efforts have significantly contributed to the charity's funding.

The team faced various challenges during their journey, including harsh weather conditions and difficult terrain. Despite these obstacles, they remained committed to their goal of raising funds for the hospice.

The funds raised will help Springhill Hospice continue its vital work in the community, providing support and care to those in need.

articles.title: M62 Lanes Reopen After Lorry Recovery at Junction 20
articles.excerpt: Lanes 2 and 3 have reopened on the M62 eastbound at Junction 20 following the recovery of a broken down lorry, but delays of up to 30 minutes remain on the approach.
articles.content_html:
Lanes 2 and 3 have reopened on the M62 eastbound at Junction 20, near Rochdale, following the recovery of a broken down lorry in lane 2.

The incident caused significant delays, with traffic reported to be backed up for up to 30 minutes on the approach to the junction.

Motorists are advised to remain cautious as congestion may persist while traffic returns to normal.

The recovery operation was completed earlier today, allowing for the reopening of the affected lanes.

articles.content_html:
A councillor visited Fieldhouse Care Home in Rochdale earlier today. Councillor Shah Wazir, who is the cabinet member for adult care, toured the facility and spoke with the manager and staff.

During the visit, Councillor Wazir observed the care and support being provided to residents. The councillor's engagement aimed to understand better the services offered at the home.

Fieldhouse Care Home is one of several facilities in the area that provide support to adults in need of care. Councillor Wazir's visit highlights the council's commitment to ensuring quality care in the community.
